title: Sadda Haq
context_note: From the film Rockstar (music: A.R. Rahman, lyrics: Irshad Kamil). Sung in-character by a young musician rebelling against every authority judging how he lives - family, society, hypocrisy, moral policing. The verses are introspective, accusatory Hindi, building a specific argument (if I act on what I believe is right and you call it wrong, then who decides what's right? why does everyone claim more authority over my life than I have myself?). The chorus breaks register entirely into blunt, colloquial Punjabi street slang - 'Sadda Haq, Aitthe Rakh' ('our right - hand it over, right here') - repeated as a chant/demand, not sung melodically so much as thrown. This code-switch itself is the song's central device: reasoned Hindi argument collapsing into a raw, vernacular, almost violent demand.

Tum logon ki, is duniya mein
Har kadam pe, insaan galat
Main sahi samajh ke jo bhi karoon
Tum kehte ho galat
Main galat hoon toh phir kaun sahi (phir kaun sahi)
Marzi se jeene ki bhi main
Kya tum sabko arzi doon
Matlab ki tum sabka mujhpe
